title: Score Descriptor Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Apply the scoring descriptors to choose the score band for each of nine observations about a rubric metric.

learningObjectives: The learner will apply the scoring descriptors to choose the correct score band for each of nine observations about a metric, with at least 8 of 9 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The terms score scale, scoring descriptor, and metric score

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: What share of the check is met?
commonMisconceptions: A score is a feeling and not a share of a check
The boundary score belongs to the lower band
assessmentOpportunities: 3 of 12 components stand alone. Which band?
18 of 22 checked facts match their sources. Which band?
0 of 6 required metadata fields are recorded. Which band?
Why does a boundary belong to the higher band?

controls.name: Six band buttons
controls.description: choose the band. The choice is final.

controls.name: Show descriptor table
controls.description: opens the table above. Opening it is exploration, not evidence.
